about_the_game:
Features

  • 4 Playable Characters, each with different effects on gameplay and a Story Sequence

  • 4 Stages with a 3-phase expanding map, adaptive soundtrack and a Unique Stage Boss

  • 34 Unique Upgrades with 5-10 levels of power

  • 26 Achievements, each contributing uniquely to meta-progression

  • 10 Unique Mini-bosses

  • 14 Unique non-Boss Enemies with unique behaviour

  • Multiple variations of enemies

  • 22 Unique pickups

Setting

In the distant future, the rogue AI Nirvana, has completed her domination of the planet. In a desperate move, the now late Professor Cera launched her final initiative: Iron Rain.

Iron Rain, is a series of highly extremely advanced armoured assault vehicles: Shire, Quarter, Morgan and Thoroughbred. Piloted by her records of her old strike team. Captain Minnie, Captain Sadie, Captain Cera, herself, and a stranger.

Gameplay

Iron Rain is playable via Keyboard + Mouse, or via Controller as a twin stick.

In Iron Rain, after selecting a character and a stage, you will be faced with a racetrack and a growing horde of enemies. Completing laps of the track will expand it, and increase the enemy onslaught, spawning mini-bosses, and eventually the Stage Boss.

To help you defeat these bosses you will destroy enemies for a variety of upgrades!

You'll reach binding speeds using these upgrades to destroy enemies in your wake !

You'll collect up to 16 items at a time and take the fight to the devastating Stage Boss's and their hordes!

After each victory or defeat your methods of destruction will unlock more upgrades, more stages and the other Playable Characters, expanding the variety of your carnage!

short_description: Iron Rain is a race to carnage! As an AI Tank Commander you battle the Nirvana AI and her robot hordes, in this Speedy Twin-Stick Roguelike. Grow overpowered with a vast range of upgrades against a varied and unique army of enemies!
